note: Campaign pictures for the public Irish cases. Each one was cut from the public ADFX paper named here, fetched from the web archive on 3 Oct 2026. Nothing comes from the private archive copies. Paul, 3 Oct: "I do want pictures. if cases have been mentioned in public, i am ok." Cases with no clean picture in their public paper (irishtimes, vodafone, btni) are shown as words. Pictures of the UK campaigns are stills cut from public videos of the ads themselves (the page each came from is listed), chosen only where the ad is from the campaign and the years the quoted paper is about. Found and not used, because the ad is from the wrong years or could not be confirmed: Guinness, John Smith's, PG Tips, Haagen-Dazs, Stella Artois, Dave, Walkers, Marie Curie, IAG Cargo, IBM, Halifax, Vodafone Ireland, BT Northern Ireland.

note_4_oct: Draft 18 (4 Oct, Sam's new shape): the page shows only the pictures named in art.json beside page.tsx, one per chapter at most, each sitting with the case that chapter tells. Chapter 2 tells two cases and shows one (IBM). Chapter 6 tells none. The fox is at the top (Paul: "the fox is always going to be at the top"). Direct Line is a still from a fan upload of the ad; the rest are from the brand, the agency, an ad archive or trade press. Two captions say plainly that the picture is not the work the paper is about (IAG Cargo, IBM).
